name: ShortPixel
couldBuild: The same shape as any optimiser: compress on upload, generate modern formats, bulk-process the back catalogue, keep the originals.
stillMissing: Identical to EWWW, and for the same reason — the compression runs on their servers and is metered in credits because it genuinely costs them per image. Rebuilding the plugin gets you a client with nothing behind it; matching the product means paying for compute either way.
requirements: Compression on upload with a lossy/lossless choice
Bulk optimisation of an existing library without timing out
WebP and AVIF generation and delivery
Originals retained so it can be undone
Credit or quota accounting the site owner can see

alternatives.name: ShortPixel (free)
alternatives.desc: A free monthly credit allowance, enough for small or slow-moving sites.

alternatives.name: Squoosh / local tooling
alternatives.desc: Free encoders you run yourself if you are willing to own the pipeline.

notes: Scored alongside EWWW deliberately: same service moat, different brand.
